What Causes Jowling?

Jowling occurs when the skin and tissues along the jawline lose elasticity and firmness, leading to sagging and a less defined jawline. Several factors contribute to the development of jowls:

Aging

The natural aging process leads to a decrease in collagen and elastin, causing the skin to sag.

Volume Loss

The reduction of facial fat pads and muscle tone can contribute to jowling.

Gravity

Over time, gravity pulls the skin downward, exacerbating sagging.

Genetics

Some individuals are genetically predisposed to develop jowls.

Lifestyle Factors

Sun exposure, smoking, and poor nutrition can accelerate skin aging.
